title: A tail is a smaller valid tile
purpose: Follow edge regions in a rectangular [5,7] times [7,3] multiplication.
contract: Block dimensions BM=4, BK=4, BN=2; ranges are half-open.
Last tile i=4..5, k=4..7, j=2..3; no contribution is discarded.
Bounds use saturating addition and min; blocked inputs must be canonical.
